extracted.name: Poppyseed Fried Bread
ingredient_lines: 1/3 cup unfiltered extra virgin olive oil
As needed oil to fry in
instruction_lines: Add the flour and dry ingredients to a bowl.
With the dry ingredients added dice the onion and add to the bowl.
Chop the bacon, dice the ham, add the olive oil and honey.
Start heating the oil. Mix in the water. Form flat little patties the size of the diameter of a baseball. They don't have to be perfect round. Deep fry in the hot oil.
Move to paper towels to absorb excessive amounts of oil. Fry in batches. If you don't need to use all the dough, you can freeze it for 6 weeks. Serve I hope you enjoy!!!
